newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus Airways to give away 5000 tickets.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus Airways to give away 5000 tickets.

text.p: Cyprus Airways, the island's national carrier, on Friday said it would give away 5,000 free tickets to travellers until the end of the year to mark its 50th anniversary celebrations.
Draws for a free one-way ticket will be held on every one of the 5,000 Cyprus Airways flights between August 1 and December 31.
The winning ticket will be valid for the route the ticket was won on for a year. Cyprus Airways employees are excluded from the offer.
